desc: Ideation: model the game as untouched indices plus available pass moves, and identify that pass parity/zero-pass behavior matters.
Reduce the state to counts of untouched piles by A_i parity (equivalently A_i-1 parity) and pass parity, with attention to small-N exceptions.
Prove the exact winning condition and implement the Python solution; run sample tests and report the verdict.
Test edge cases: N=1, N=2, N=3, all even, all odd, mixed parities, and large A_i values.
